title: Food-related energy consumption can help reveal poverty in rural Chinese households
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76026-0

This study introduces the Energy Engel Coefficient, a food-related energy consumption indicator. Using household survey data from China, it identifies low-income rural households not identified by traditional income-based poverty measures.

title: Enantioselective synthesis of ring-constrained biaryls via a twist-expand-seal strategy
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76125-y

The authors report a “twist-expand-seal” strategy for synthesizing a unique class of cyclic biaryls that exhibit axial chirality and conformational constraint, with adjustable ring sizes.

title: An agent-guided peptide hydrogel bio-stabilizer clamps pericellular viscoelastic drift
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76070-w

Here, the authors present ViscoClamp, a hydrogel that stabilizes the local mechanical environment around cells, restores bone-forming activity under diabetes-related stress, and improves jaw and skull bone repair in animal models.

title: Achieving enhanced and robust propane selective oxidative dehydrogenation via electrically-driven continuous chemical looping
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76063-9

Oxidative propane dehydrogenation (OPDH) for propylene production is promising but limited by overoxidation. Here, the authors report an electrically driven chemical looping process using solid oxide electrolysis cells, which achieves high propylene selectivity in CO2 OPDH via anode catalyst design.

title: Microbial drought resistance is achieved at the expense of soil carbon loss
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76033-1

This study shows that soil microbes adapt to aridity by shifting their yield, resource acquisition and stress tolerance strategies, and that aridification amplifies the effects of these strategies on soil carbon mineralization.

title: Host-derived lactic acid disrupts IFN efficacy via antiviral inhibition and proinflammatory amplification
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76000-w

This study identifies host-produced lactic acid as a critical factor limiting the efficacy of IFN treatment after viral infection. Combining IFN with stiripentol, an approved LDH inhibitor, restores antiviral activity and alleviates inflammation in viral infection models.

title: Large language model driven multicenter prediction and explainable risk attribution of acute kidney injury
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76029-x

This multicenter study introduces a large language model framework for real-time prediction and explainable risk attribution of acute kidney injury. It has the potential to support early clinical detection and prevention.

title: Direct electrosynthesis of acetamide from CO<sub>2</sub> and nitrate via an atomically engineered dual-site catalyst
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 27 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76064-8

Producing amides sustainably from abundant feedstocks remains challenging because carbon–carbon and carbon–nitrogen bond formation competes kinetically. Here, the authors report a dual-site catalyst pairing nickel single atoms with copper nanoclusters that directs CO2 and nitrate co-reduction toward acetamide.
